description: Given an appliance model number and optionally a category (water-filter, ice-maker, dryer-belt, dryer-heating-element), return the genuine part number(s) for that model with the fit source URL and read date. Ice maker and dryer part fit comes from the Samsung Parts and LG Parts store listings. Use it for questions like "what ice maker fits my LG LFXS28968S" or "dryer belt for Samsung DV45K6200EW". Includes the PartAnswers page URL to cite.

category.description: Optional part category; omit to get every category we cover for the model

model_number.description: Model number from the appliance label

name: find_part_for_model
title: Find genuine appliance parts for a model
